issues.failure_explanation: The formula y(t) = b(x)(e^{ta(x)}-1)/a(x) + ye^{ta(x)} is the exact solution of the frozen sub-problem y' = a(x)y + b(x), valid only for a(x) not equal to 0. At x = plus or minus 1 (where a(x) = 1-x^2 = 0), the formula evaluates to 0/0 and is undefined. The correct solution at a(x) = 0 is y(t) = y + b(x)t. The Van der Pol trajectory passes through x = plus or minus 1, so the singularity is encountered along the solution path.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the phi-function phi(t,a) = (e^{ta}-1)/a for a not equal to 0 and phi(t,0) = t, or add a separate case for a(x) = 0 with the solution y(t) = y + b(x)t.
issues.overall_effect: The Van der Pol splitting algorithm is undefined when the frozen x-value equals plus or minus 1 (where a(x) = 0). Numerical evaluation near these values also suffers from catastrophic cancellation.
issues.title: Van der Pol sub-problem solution formula has unhandled singularity at a(x) = 0
issues.why_classification: The fix is a short, local, routine repair (adding a limiting case or using the standard phi-function). All substantive claims and guarantees are preserved with no new construction.

issues.failure_explanation: The convention from Remark rem324 defines tau_{x,y}(t,z) as solving z' = F_3(x,y,z) with x and y frozen. In step 1, the subscripts (y_k, z_k) freeze y and z instead of x and y; the correct call is tau_{x_k,y_k}(t/2n, z_k). In step 5, the subscripts (y_{k+1}, z_{k+1}) are wrong (should be x_{k+1}, y_{k+1}) and z_{k+1} appears as a subscript while being the quantity computed on the left side (circular reference).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Change the subscripts in step 1 from tau_{y_k, z_k} to tau_{x_k, y_k} and in step 5 from tau_{y_{k+1}, z_{k+1}} to tau_{x_{k+1}, y_{k+1}}.
issues.overall_effect: The Strang 3D algorithm as written solves wrong sub-problems at steps 1 and 5 (freezing incorrect variables), producing incorrect numerical approximations for three-dimensional systems.
issues.title: Strang 3D algorithm in Appendix app32 specifies wrong frozen variables and has circular reference
issues.why_classification: The corrections are forced and local (changing subscript labels to match the defined convention). After correction, the algorithm works correctly with no new construction needed.
